units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 21:22">Targ. Jud. XXI, 22</cite> <he>חֲנוּנוּן להון</he> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>חנינינון</he>) be gracious to them.—

<cite ref="Pesachim 110b:1">Pes. 110ᵇ</cite> (in an incantation) <he>אדחֲנַנִי וחֲנַנְכִי וכ׳</he> while He graced me and yourselves, I had not come to that (v. Ar. s. v. <cite ref="E00808"><he>הר</he></cite> 8, a. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note for var. lect.).
